_evidence: 0x0040af67 (eax = record index, the caller 0x40afb2 passes word [0x868558]>>1; spec 0..63) starts at the lap start [0x891504] + eax*0x160 and tests 8-record groups of the 0x160-byte segment array: it ors byte +0x48 & 0x30 of 8 consecutive records (loop) and returns the first group where all are clear (je 0x40afb1), else advances 8 records, at most 24 groups and only while the group start is below [0x866ecc]-0x5800 (64 records before the lap end); otherwise it executes int3 (0x40afb0, a deliberate debug break, i.e. a state the game never reaches: random pointers faulted every case). Domain: lap start 0x8943a0, lap end record 192..200 (limit record >= 128); bytes +0x48 of records 0..119 draw from 16 values, 3 of which have bit 4 and/or 5 (a group is free in about a fifth of the cases, so first-group hits and multi-group advances both occur), and records 120..134 have bits 4/5 clear (other bits vary): for every start 0..63 some group start eax+8g lies in 120..127 with g <= 15 (< 24 groups, below the 128 limit), so a free group is always found and the int3 block is unreachable in valid states. No other record is read.
